charts.title: HD 89345 b: orbits around HD 89345
charts.description: The orbits of HD 89345's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HD 89345 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Bourrier et al. 2023 (2023A&A...669A..63B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname BOURRIER_ET_AL__2023): P 11.8144024 d

charts.title: HD 89345 b: its transit
charts.description: HD 89345 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 2 sectors (45, 46) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 350020859, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 23-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 23-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
